description.en: Serves a QR pairing page from the desktop; after the phone scans it, a mobile web UI opens over the home LAN or a Cloudflare quick tunnel and shows the live session feed, approval prompts and a floating desktop widget.
description.zh: 在电脑端生成扫码配对页，手机扫码后通过局域网或 Cloudflare 隧道打开移动端界面，查看实时消息与授权提醒，桌面端带悬浮球。
